note: Single source for AUTO-POPULATING each Open*Hub. Read by _repos/openhubforai/backend/src/openhubforai/discovery.py (an OpenClaw plugin is auto-derived per hub), _repos/openhubforai/backend/src/openhubforai/generators.py (the generate channel), _repos/openhubforai/backend/src/openhubforai/hub_settings.py (settings default per hub), and _repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/hub_freshness.py. THREE contribution channels per hub: (1) DISCOVER - OpenClaw/Hermes + keep_hub_fresh search public sources, unbounded->bounded (api > search > scrape); (2) GENERATE - a named internal producer emits candidates from our own systems (the descent brain, the method catalog, run receipts, the template registry); (3) INTAKE - the owner feeds raw OKF/links/text via scripts/hub_engine_runner.py --ingest. serves_truth=false: everything is a CANDIDATE, served only after the hub's verify/rank gate (discovery!=trust).
recursive_flywheel: The tools/skills/harnesses that DO the population are themselves hub components: OpenToolsHub feeds OpenClaw better tools, OpenSkillsHub feeds Teleon better digest/plan skills, OpenHubForAI feeds the verify/rank gate better ratings. Populating the hubs makes future population better.
governance: tenant-private never global without opt-in contribute
respect robots/ToS + official APIs; login-walled sources (e.g. facebook) need owner --ingest, not scraping

contribution_modes.discover: content exists in the wild; finders search public sources (github topics, HN, registries, awesome-lists)
contribution_modes.generate: content is PRODUCED by our own systems (no public source); a named generator emits candidates
contribution_modes.both: discover public prior art AND generate from our own runs/brain/catalog

generators.corpus_acquisition: build governed context packs from vetted sources (the negative-space corpus grid)
generators.skill_digestion: digest a raw skill into an evaluated SKILL with an example + lift measure
generators.skill_to_tool_converter: convert a skill/persona into a callable, typed tool (the descent demo)
generators.harness_synthesis: synthesize a measurable eval harness for a capability
generators.eval_runs: our eval/benchmark runs emit evidence records (not authority)
generators.template_instantiator: the shared template registry renders candidate template shells
generators.endpoint_probe: probe an LLM endpoint/gateway -> a due-diligence record (model info, limits, jurisdiction)
generators.rl_env_synthesis: Repo2RLEnv-style generators emit verifiable eval environments + reward specs
generators.sandbox_probe: probe a sandbox runtime -> risk/conformance profile
generators.agent_run_receipts: agent-runtime adapters emit run receipts from executed runs
generators.run_receipts: Teleon runs emit portable signed receipts (the attestation face)
generators.run_state: Teleon runs emit durable governed working-state snapshots
generators.method_catalog: architecture/descent_method_catalog.json emits method primitives (filtered by axis/keyword) + vendorable module candidates

OpenToolsHub.verify_bar: callable + has a name + a source handle

OpenHubForAI.verify_bar: runs a measurable eval + reports a metric

OpenBenchmarkHub.verify_bar: a reproducible benchmark with a method + a metric (evidence, not authority)

OpenReviewHub.verify_bar: a capability/reproducibility verdict with cited evidence

OpenTemplatesHub.verify_bar: a renderable template shell with typed sections

OpenEndpointHub.verify_bar: a due-diligence record: model info, limits, jurisdiction (free/shared-key lanes quarantined)

OpenEnvironmentHub.verify_bar: a verifiable environment with a reward spec + a held-out check

OpenSandboxHub.verify_bar: a sandbox runtime with a risk/conformance profile

OpenAgentHub.verify_bar: an agent-runtime adapter behind a port + a run receipt (never serves truth)

OpenReceiptHub.verify_bar: a portable signed receipt with a verifiable lineage chain

OpenStateHub.verify_bar: a durable, replayable state snapshot with version + lineage

OpenRoutingHub.verify_bar: a routing policy / preference card with a measured trade-off (cost vs quality)

OpenReconciliationHub.verify_bar: a reconciliation method with a measured collapse/precision on a held-out set

OpenHardeningHub.verify_bar: a hardening method that makes brittle text refreshing/robust with a before/after

OpenEnrichmentHub.verify_bar: an enrichment method adding metadata/relationships with a source handle

OpenOptimizationHub.verify_bar: a pack-shaping method with measured token/cost savings + preserved answer-critical facts

OpenVerificationHub.verify_bar: a verification method binding claim->source with a proof/citation
